description: Search Bulgarian real-estate listings on imotai.bg by city, district, property type, price range, area range and rooms. Returns up to 25 listings with structured fields, a link to each, and a district-level marketContext block (district average price per m² and how far this listing deviates from it). No contact details or free-text descriptions.

rooms.description: CSV of room counts, e.g. "2,3"; "5+" for 5 or more.
